description: This file defines the controller class for the AOR Reports module in SuiteCRM. It contains various action methods for handling AJAX requests related to report module fields, parameters, charts, export functions, PDF download, and relationship management. The class extends SugarController and utilizes several SuiteCRM-specific utilities, such as BeanFactory, getRelatedModule, and PDFWrapper, to facilitate report generation and data manipulation.

classes.name: AOR_ReportsController
classes.description: Controller class handling AJAX actions and report operations for the AOR Reports module in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: action_getModuleFields
methods.description: Returns module fields for a specified module or related module based on request parameters.

methods.name: action_getVarDefs
methods.description: Outputs JSON-encoded field definitions of a specified module bean.

methods.name: action_getModuleTreeData
methods.description: Retrieves and outputs module tree data asynchronously based on request parameters.

methods.name: action_getModuleRelationships
methods.description: Outputs module relationship data for a specified module.

methods.name: action_changeReportPage
methods.description: Handles pagination within a report, rebuilding report output based on offset and group parameters.

methods.name: action_getParametersForReport
methods.description: Returns report condition parameters as JSON for a given report record.

methods.name: action_getChartsForReport
methods.description: Fetches linked chart information for a report and outputs as JSON.

methods.name: action_addToProspectList
methods.description: Adds report-derived beans to a Prospect List via relationship links.

methods.name: action_chartReport
methods.description: Builds a chart report visualization.

methods.name: action_export
methods.description: Exports report data as CSV if user has permissions.

methods.name: action_downloadPDF
methods.description: Generates and outputs a PDF version of the report, including charts if specified.

methods.name: action_getModuleFunctionField
methods.description: Returns the list of functions or operations applicable to a module field, with options for select inputs.

methods.name: action_getModuleOperatorField
methods.description: Provides operator options for a field based on its type, e.g., equals, greater than.

methods.name: action_getFieldTypeOptions
methods.description: Outputs options for field types for a specific module and field.

methods.name: action_getActionFieldTypeOptions
methods.description: Outputs options for action field types, e.g., value, field, round robin.

methods.name: action_getModuleFieldType
methods.description: Provides a form element for selecting a module field or related type based on the request.

methods.name: action_getModuleFieldTypeSet
methods.description: Outputs a form element to select and set a module field or related type.

methods.name: action_getModuleField
methods.description: Outputs a form element for selecting a module field with the specified parameters.

methods.name: action_getRelFieldTypeSet
methods.description: Outputs a form element for selecting a related module field.

methods.name: action_getRelActionFieldTypeOptions
methods.description: Provides options for related action field types.
